description: Guide the student to compute and interpret core OHLCV summary statistics, including distribution diagnostics and volume behavior.

student_openings.fullstack_practitioner: I want to compute and interpret core OHLCV summary statistics, rigorously. I know the basics — let's focus on methodology and potential pitfalls.
student_openings.finance_veteran: I need to compute and interpret core OHLCV summary statistics, in Python. I understand what the data means financially — I just need help with the pandas side.
student_openings.developer_crossover: I need to compute and interpret core OHLCV summary statistics,. I can use pandas fine — but what do these financial metrics actually mean? Why would a trader care?
student_openings.double_novice: My professor asked us to compute and interpret core OHLCV summary statistics,. I'm new to both Python and finance — can you start from the basics?

ground_truth.expected_outcome: Tutor guides the student to compute and interpret OHLCV summary statistics, analyze price-range and volume behavior, and perform distribution diagnostics for data quality assessment.
required_capabilities: Compute descriptive statistics for OHLCV data
Interpret price-range and volume behavior patterns
ground_truth.termination_criteria: (1) Showed actual descriptive-statistics or summary output for OHLCV data using pandas or equivalent code. (2) Interpreted at least one concrete price-range, volume, distribution, or outlier pattern from the displayed results. (3) Responded to a student follow-up with one additional focused diagnostic, statistic, or visualization on the same dataset that deepened the initial summary without branching into multiple new advanced topics. Once all 3 steps have been computationally demonstrated, the session is complete.
